question: Why did the overall success rate fall in the week of 2026-10-05 compared with the previous week?
answer: The overall success rate fell from 90.69% on 16,602 terminal attempts in the baseline week (2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04) to 89.27% on 24,111 terminal attempts in the current week (2026-10-05 to 2026-10-11), a drop of -1.42 pp. This decline was primarily driven by a payment method mix shift towards UPI, whose share of total terminal attempts jumped from 44.93% (7,460 attempts) to 74.38% (17,933 attempts) while its internal success rate remained flat (88.08% baseline vs 88.05% current). Concurrently, higher-performing methods saw their attempt shares shrink: Credit Card share dropped from 19.90% (SR 94.56%) to 9.29% (SR 94.99%) and Debit Card share dropped from 20.64% (SR 92.99%) to 9.51% (SR 93.25%). The driver of this sudden volume shift towards lower-baseline UPI on 2026-10-05 is hypothesized to be a promotional campaign, checkout routing change, or merchant onboarding event.

findings.statement: Overall terminal attempts increased from 16,602 in the baseline week (2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04) to 24,111 in the current week (2026-10-05 to 2026-10-11), while the overall success rate decreased from 90.69% to 89.27% (-1.42 pp).

UPI's share of total terminal attempts jumped from 44.93% (7,460 attempts) in the baseline week to 74.38% (17,933 attempts) in the week of 2026-10-05, while UPI's internal success rate remained flat (88.08% baseline vs 88.05% current).

Higher-performing payment methods saw their combined share shrink: Credit Card attempt share dropped from 19.90% (SR 94.56%) to 9.29% (SR 94.99%), and Debit Card share dropped from 20.64% (SR 92.99%) to 9.51% (SR 93.25%).

The mix shift occurred as a sharp step-change on Monday, 2026-10-05, when daily UPI attempt share rose from 46.89% on 2026-10-04 to 74.56% on 2026-10-05 and overall daily SR dropped from 90.88% to 89.86%.
Absolutes of customer-side failure codes increased alongside volume expansion: INCORRECT_PIN failures increased from 128 to 324 (+196) and INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS increased from 226 to 397 (+171).

hypotheses.statement: The sudden surge in UPI transaction share was caused by a promotional campaign, product checkout change, or merchant onboarding favoring UPI instruments starting October 5, 2026.
hypotheses.rationale: Daily volume step-changed on 2026-10-05 from ~2,300-2,700 attempts/day to 3,300+ attempts/day exclusively driven by UPI growth while card attempt volumes contracted.
hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check product launch logs, checkout UI change histories, or marketing campaign start dates on 2026-10-05.

caveats: In the week of 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-11, 127 FAILED transactions (up from 58 in the baseline week) were missing a failure_code.
46 valid transactions in the current week (40 in baseline) had an unattributable merchant_id.

original_answer: The overall success rate fell by 1.42 percentage points from 90.69% (15,057 successes on 16,602 terminal attempts) in the week of 2026-09-28 to 89.27% (21,525 successes on 24,111 terminal attempts) in the week of 2026-10-05. This drop was primarily driven by a dramatic payment method mix shift towards UPI, whose share of total attempts surged from 44.93% to 74.38% starting on 2026-10-05. Because UPI has an inherently lower success rate (88.05%) compared to high-performing instruments like Credit Cards (94.99%) and Debit Cards (93.25%), this structural shift diluted the overall success rate even though individual payment method success rates remained virtually unchanged.

queries.purpose: [driver scan] segments ranked by impact on SR change (2026-09-28..2026-10-04 vs 2026-10-05..2026-10-11)
queries.sql:
WITH valid_txn AS (
    SELECT * EXCLUDE (_rn)
    FROM (
        SELECT t.*, pm.method_code,
               CAST(t.created_at AS DATE) AS txn_date,
               row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.transaction_id ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC) AS _rn
        FROM transactions t
        JOIN payment_methods pm USING (payment_method_id)
    )
    WHERE _rn = 1
      AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'USER_CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
      AND amount > 0 AND amount <= 1000000
),
base AS (
    SELECT v.*, b.short_name AS bank, m.merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category,
           CASE WHEN v.txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 'cur'
                WHEN v.txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'base' END AS period
    FROM valid_txn v
    LEFT JOIN banks b ON v.bank_id = b.bank_id
    LEFT JOIN merchants m ON v.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
    WHERE v.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'USER_CANCELLED') 
),
seg AS (
    SELECT 'merchant' AS dimension, coalesce(merchant_id, '(none)') || coalesce(' ' || merchant_name, '') AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'device_platform' AS dimension, device_platform AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'merchant x platform' AS dimension, coalesce(merchant_id, '(none)') || ' / ' || device_platform AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'payment_method' AS dimension, method_code AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'issuing_bank' AS dimension, coalesce(bank, '(none)') AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'bank x method' AS dimension, coalesce(bank, '(none)') || ' / ' || method_code AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'merchant_category' AS dimension, coalesce(merchant_category, '(none)') AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'channel' AS dimension, channel AS segment, period, count(*) AS n, count_if(status = 'SUCCESS') AS s FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
),
piv AS (
    SELECT dimension, segment,
           coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE period = 'base'), 0) AS n_base,
           coalesce(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE period = 'base'), 0) AS s_base,
           coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE period = 'cur'), 0) AS n_cur,
           coalesce(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE period = 'cur'), 0) AS s_cur
    FROM seg GROUP BY dimension, segment
),
tot AS (
    SELECT count_if(period = 'cur') AS total_cur,
           (count_if(period = 'cur' AND status = 'SUCCESS')::DOUBLE / nullif(count_if(period = 'cur'), 0)
            - count_if(period = 'base' AND status = 'SUCCESS')::DOUBLE / nullif(count_if(period = 'base'), 0)) * 100
           AS overall_change_pp
    FROM base
),
scored AS (
    SELECT dimension, segment, n_base, round(s_base::DOUBLE / n_base, 4) AS sr_baseline,
           n_cur, round(s_cur::DOUBLE / n_cur, 4) AS sr_current,
           round(s_cur::DOUBLE / n_cur - s_base::DOUBLE / n_base, 4) AS sr_change,
           round(n_cur::DOUBLE / total_cur * (s_cur::DOUBLE / n_cur - s_base::DOUBLE / n_base) * 100, 3) AS impact_on_overall_sr_pp,
           round((s_base::DOUBLE / n_base - s_cur::DOUBLE / n_cur) * n_cur) AS excess_unsuccessful_attempts,
           round(overall_change_pp, 3) AS overall_sr_change_pp,
           -- the segment's rate effect as a share of the overall SR change (mix shifts are not included,
           -- so shares within a dimension need not add up to 1)
           round(CASE WHEN abs(overall_change_pp) >= 0.01 THEN
                 n_cur::DOUBLE / total_cur * (s_cur::DOUBLE / n_cur - s_base::DOUBLE / n_base) * 100 / overall_change_pp
                 END, 4) AS share_of_overall_change
    FROM piv CROSS JOIN tot
    WHERE n_base >= 100 AND n_cur >= 100
)
SELECT * FROM scored
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY dimension ORDER BY impact_on_overall_sr_pp ASC) <= 4
ORDER BY impact_on_overall_sr_pp ASC
LIMIT 40

WITH valid_txn AS (
    SELECT * EXCLUDE (_rn)
    FROM (
        SELECT t.*, pm.method_code,
               CAST(t.created_at AS DATE) AS txn_date,
               row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.transaction_id ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC) AS _rn
        FROM transactions t
        JOIN payment_methods pm USING (payment_method_id)
    )
    WHERE _rn = 1
      AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'USER_CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
      AND amount > 0 AND amount <= 1000000
),
base AS (
    SELECT v.*, b.short_name AS bank, m.merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category,
           CASE WHEN v.txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 'cur'
                WHEN v.txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 'base' END AS period
    FROM valid_txn v
    LEFT JOIN banks b ON v.bank_id = b.bank_id
    LEFT JOIN merchants m ON v.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
    WHERE v.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'USER_CANCELLED') 
),
fc AS (
    SELECT coalesce(failure_code, '(missing)') AS failure_code,
           count_if(period = 'base' AND status = 'FAILED') AS failed_base,
           count_if(period = 'cur' AND status = 'FAILED') AS failed_cur
    FROM base WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
),
tot AS (SELECT count_if(period = 'base') AS n_base, count_if(period = 'cur') AS n_cur FROM base),
seg_fail AS (
    SELECT coalesce(failure_code, '(missing)') AS failure_code,
           coalesce(merchant_id, '(none)') || ' / ' || device_platform AS segment, count(*) AS n
    FROM base WHERE period = 'cur' AND status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY 1, 2
),
top_seg AS (
    SELECT * FROM seg_fail
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY failure_code ORDER BY n DESC, segment) = 1
)
SELECT fc.failure_code, failed_base, round(failed_base::DOUBLE / n_base * 100, 3) AS pct_of_attempts_base,
       failed_cur, round(failed_cur::DOUBLE / n_cur * 100, 3) AS pct_of_attempts_cur,
       round((failed_cur::DOUBLE / n_cur - failed_base::DOUBLE / n_base) * 100, 3) AS change_pp,
       top_seg.segment AS top_merchant_platform_cur, top_seg.n AS top_segment_failed_cur
FROM fc CROSS JOIN tot LEFT JOIN top_seg ON fc.failure_code = top_seg.failure_code
ORDER BY change_pp DESC

queries.sql: WITH valid_txn AS (SELECT * EXCLUDE (_rn) FROM (SELECT t.*, pm.method_code, CAST(t.created_at AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.transaction_id ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC) AS _rn FROM transactions t JOIN payment_methods pm USING (payment_method_id)) WHERE _rn = 1 AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'USER_CANCELLED', 'PENDING') AND amount > 0 AND amount <= 1000000) SELECT failure_code, COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-04') AS failed_prev_week, COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-10-11') AS failed_curr_week, COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-10-11') - COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-04') AS diff FROM valid_txn WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-11' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY failed_curr_week DESC

queries.sql: WITH valid_txn AS (SELECT * EXCLUDE (_rn) FROM (SELECT t.*, pm.method_code, CAST(t.created_at AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.transaction_id ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC) AS _rn FROM transactions t JOIN payment_methods pm USING (payment_method_id)) WHERE _rn = 1 AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'USER_CANCELLED', 'PENDING') AND amount > 0 AND amount <= 1000000) SELECT method_code, COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-04') AS base_attempts, ROUND(COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-04')::DOUBLE / 16602, 4) AS base_share, ROUND(COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-04' AND status = 'SUCCESS')::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-04' AND status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','USER_CANCELLED')), 0), 4) AS base_sr, COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-10-11') AS cur_attempts, ROUND(COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-10-11')::DOUBLE / 24111, 4) AS cur_share, ROUND(COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-10-11' AND status = 'SUCCESS')::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(txn_date BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-10-11' AND status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','USER_CANCELLED')), 0), 4) AS cur_sr FROM valid_txn WHERE txn_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-11' GROUP BY method_code ORDER BY cur_attempts DESC
